Resolves #21248

`Neo.timeline.Column` now sizes its own cell: `height: 100%; width: 100%` in `resources/scss/src/timeline/Column.scss`. A plain grid that mounts it draws its bars at the row's height, so `examples/timeline/basic` no longer shows an empty day. The scheduler's and the Gantt chart's copies of that rule are deleted, because the column owns it now. A new e2e spec loads the example in all five themes it declares and fails on `dev`. `test/playwright/e2e/timeline` joins the CI e2e run paths.

Evidence: L3 (the example measured and rendered in a real browser before and after, and the new e2e red on `dev`, green here) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-3).

Outside CI: the same spec on unmodified `dev` failed in all five themes, each with "Expected > 24, Received 2". |
